newsitem.title: JAPAN: Dlr steady after gains eroded by Tietmeyer remarks.
newsitem.headline: Dlr steady after gains eroded by Tietmeyer remarks.

text.p: *Dollar steady after shedding some early gains on remarks by Bundesbank President Hans Tietmeyer.
*Tietmeyer said United States was interested in strong dollar but not in a stronger one.

*Dollar earlier rose to high of 127.10 yen and set new three-year high of 1.7395 marks as lack of specific reference to "weak yen" as shared concern of Group of Seven (G7) nations forced traders to cover short positions.
*Bank of Japan maintained utter silence despite dollar's rally this morning.
